record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set Adam learning rate to 6e-4 and weight decay to 1e-5, retaining MAXLEN=64, hidden size 64, six blocks, dropout 0.15 and batch size 128. Smaller updates coupled with mild parameter regularization may improve generalization without repeating the previous simultaneous reductions in history length and dropout. Keep architecture, embedding parameterization, features, scoring, readout and loss unchanged; retain seed 42, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch.
